=== HINT 3: Method Guidance ===

CHOOSE_ACTION:
- Do NOT print options (engine already did)
- Use a loop to keep asking until input is valid
- Convert to int, subtract 1, validate range
- Return the 0-based index

COMPUTE_DAMAGE:
- Subtract armour from base damage
- If the result is negative, return 0

BONUS: CALCULATE_CRITICAL_HIT:
- Optional challenge
- 15% chance to double damage (or your own design)
- Return a TUPLE: (final_damage, is_critical)

KEY CONCEPTS:
- choose_action returns an INDEX (0, 1, 2, or 3)
- compute_damage must clamp at 0
- calculate_critical_hit returns a tuple (damage, flag)

Run validate.py to check your work!
